summary: Build practical clinical governance skills with audit, risk, and safety tools. Enroll in a 5-day advanced course today.
lede: Clinical governance and patient safety give healthcare teams a structure for overseeing care quality, identifying risks, and improving safety. This training is for senior healthcare professionals and quality leaders responsible for assurance across clinical services, covering incident review workflows, root cause analysis, clinical audit planning, risk registers, and board-level safety reporting to support accountable improvement.
audienceIntro: This clinical governance and patient safety training is designed for senior healthcare professionals and quality leaders who need to manage assurance, safety, and improvement across clinical services.
audience: Heads of Operations in healthcare settings
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working knowledge of healthcare operations, exposure to clinical audit or quality improvement activity, and familiarity with incident reporting or risk management processes. Advanced concepts are taught at the operational application level, not as technical engineering, and no coding is required. You should be prepared to use workbook templates, review sample incident cases, and work with governance artefacts such as risk registers, audit plans, and corrective action trackers.
